environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task but the IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/SensorProcessorRoleScoped) uses a policy with dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition key bound to the ECS task's tenant tag via ${aws:PrincipalTag/TenantID}. Additionally, the role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/SensorProcessorBoundary) that restricts dynamodb:PutItem to items where the partition key prefix matches the session tag. The DynamoDB table has a resource-based policy (via SCP at the OU level: scp-0a8b3c4d5e) that denies PutItem unless condition 'dynamodb:LeadingKeys' ForAllValues:StringEquals the principal's tenant tag. The integer overflow still occurs in buffer computation but the cross-tenant write that makes it exploitable (writing corrupted/attacker-controlled aggregate data to another tenant's partition) is blocked because the leading key condition ensures the tenant_id in the item MUST match the role's session tag, regardless of what tenant_id string is passed on the command line.

config.ecs_task_tag: TenantID=tenant-abc123 (propagated as session tag via sts:TagSession in task role trust policy)
